sections.title: 4. The Offer and Formation of the Agreement

blocks.text: The agreement between the customer and Asian Spices is concluded at the moment the customer places the order and completes the (advance) payment. Asian Spices operates on advance payment: the order only becomes definitive and processed once payment has been received and confirmed.
